title: Workflow Runtime
description: A fixed review pipeline runs in parallel, records a journal, and resumes completed agent calls from cache.

steps.content: Review this change across correctness, security, performance, and style.
steps.annotation: The goal is open-ended, but the review procedure has a fixed shape.
One tool call hands deterministic orchestration to the workflow runtime.
The product runtime returns a claim ticket while work continues in the background.
Each item advances independently through the scripted stages.

steps.content: phase=Verify -> adversarial checks run in parallel
steps.annotation: Structured results cross a validation boundary before aggregation.
Every completed agent call is checkpointed before the final notification.
Semantic keys reuse completed work without depending on concurrency order.
